style_summary: Minimal future-sport product concepts pair tactile podded outsoles with quiet athletic gestures, modular editorial panels, ice-cool architecture and signal-coral accents.

environment_variables.SUBJECT: Athlete, gesture and tactile footwear
environment_variables.SUBJECT_ACTION: Quiet athletic gesture that tests the tactile outsole
environment_variables.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: Conceptual performance shoe with repeated rounded pods
environment_variables.LOCATION: Ice-cool modular architecture from the scene
environment_variables.BACKGROUND_ELEMENTS: Editorial panels, gutters and generous negative space
environment_variables.WARDROBE_STYLE: Quiet athletic clothing that keeps the shoe dominant

style_fidelity_anchors: [CORE] Present a conceptual performance shoe with a distinctive outsole made from repeated rounded tactile pods; the pod structure is the key product signature, while all branding remains blank.
[CORE] Combine oversized product macro views with a human athletic gesture or still pose, suggesting a conversation between foot sensation and movement.
[CORE] Use clean modular editorial panels or sharply separated light and dark image fields, with disciplined gutters, generous negative space and small restrained technical labels.
[CORE] Limit color to cool ice white, blue-gray and deep graphite, punctuated by a strong signal-coral or magenta-red outsole accent and occasional warm pod tips.
[CORE] Render product and people as polished, believable campaign photography with smooth studio gradients, precise material highlights and a restrained futuristic sports-lab mood.
[FLEX] Let each concept choose between airborne action, quiet stance, macro material study and seated recovery; connect the moments with repeated pod geometry, contact marks or fine sensory paths.
[FLEX] Recompose modular panels independently for portrait and landscape, shifting scale, panel count and dark/light balance without losing the tactile shoe as a visual anchor.
source_content_to_avoid: Nike name, swoosh, Mind product name, logo, trademark and original copy
Exact reference collage arrangement and the same airborne female pose
The exact bright red shoe outsole design from the source image
Original model, cable-like hair trail and dark locker scene copied literally

visual_deconstruction.source: A modular concept board alternates a coral podded outsole macro, airborne athlete with a close red sole, quiet side-profile study with a fine flowing line, dark locker-room seated figure and underside sole view.
visual_deconstruction.hierarchy: Tactile outsole and athletic body alternate between product scale and human scale; coral-red contact pods punctuate cool, precise environments.

composition.principle: An editorial concept board with a few asymmetrical image panels: one tactile outsole/product macro and one human movement or rest moment, separated by precise gutters and quiet cool-toned space.
composition.adaptation: Portrait can stack macro, figure and technical detail vertically; landscape can distribute product and person across a wider panel rhythm. Each case changes focal scale and panel balance to express its idea.

typography.form: Small neutral grotesk labels, compact uppercase concept title and occasional concise technical annotation; never a giant headline.
typography.hierarchy: Visual panels dominate. Keep text sparse, aligned to panel edges and secondary to product and gesture.

color_palette.frame: Ice white, cool pale blue-gray and deep graphite or navy, with signal coral outsole and occasional warm peach pod tips.
color_palette.photo: Natural skin and restrained wardrobe colors; smooth studio gradient transitions rather than loud multicolor effects.
color_palette.dominant_hex: Approximate dominant colors sampled from the style preview, most to least common: #2B313A, #464E5A, #7A8495, #959FB0, #626876.

photographic_direction.camera: Alternating extreme outsole macro, low wide-angle athletic action and calm side-profile or seated portrait; realistic proportions and refined campaign lighting.
photographic_direction.texture: Clean high-end digital product photography. Smooth gradients, crisp pod geometry and subtle knit, rubber and matte-composite texture; no print grain, distress or heavy blur.
photographic_direction.light: Soft directional studio light with precise glossy highlights on rubber and quiet cool ambient fill in architecture.

design_rules: Repeat rounded outsole pods as the main product motif, with no visible brand marks.
Balance at least one product-scale view with one human-scale gesture or pose in each campaign board.
Use coral only to emphasize outsole, contact or pressure points; keep surrounding palette cool and restrained.
Keep panel divisions clean and purposeful, with small quiet technical labeling only.
Give each case a different sensory metaphor and composition, not only a changed title or shoe color.
do: Make the tactile sole architecture read clearly, especially in close-up panels.
Use the relationship between a body gesture and the sole's contact surface to express the case idea.
Mix intimate product detail with calm architectural space.
avoid: Copied logos, slogans, signature brand shapes or visible product names.
Crowded technical diagrams or noisy interface decoration.
A generic shoe catalog grid without a human or sensory idea.
negative_prompt: No Nike, swoosh, Reebok, brand marks, legible tiny fake copy, watermark, copied source model or exact collage, oversized decorative typography, cluttered HUD, glowing sci-fi circuits, extreme neon, malformed feet or fingers, extra shoes, distorted pod geometry, low-resolution product textures.

values.SUBJECT: An adult athlete holds a quiet one-leg balance pose on a low matte plinth; a second panel shows the same foot landing softly, the rounded tactile sole pods visibly aligned beneath it.
values.SCENE: Ice-blue studio fading to pale gray with one deep graphite panel; white technical knit shoe with signal-coral podded outsole and subtle peach pod tips.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Balance is a shift of pressure, not a jump. Let the foot's contact points move from heel to forefoot across a small sequence of modular panels; keep the athlete calm and centered, outsole macro large enough to read.
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: White technical knit shoe with a signal-coral podded outsole and subtle peach pod tips

values.SUBJECT: An adult woman athlete caught in a compact upward leap, one bent leg bringing the podded outsole close to camera; a second narrow panel studies the outsole pods in a rhythmic repeated row.
values.SCENE: Dark graphite movement studio split by a pale blue-gray vertical field, white outfit and vivid coral-red outsole with warm peach pod tips.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Turn the repeated sole pods into a visual beat: alternate close outsole circles with the suspended athlete. Use a rising diagonal panel cadence and restrained coral echoes, while the figure stays graceful and anatomically clear.
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: White athletic shoe with a vivid coral-red podded outsole and warm peach pod tips

values.SUBJECT: An adult male runner in side profile walks slowly across a pale studio floor; each step leaves a neat sequence of rounded contact impressions that mirror the pod pattern, with a macro view of one sole nearby.
values.SCENE: Quiet cool-white gallery with blue-gray floor and a distant deep navy wall, pale gray apparel, coral contact impressions and a clean white shoe.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Memory becomes a trail of pressure marks. Use an elongated side-profile panel with the contact imprints receding into space, balanced by one precise podded-sole macro. A fine sensory line may connect shoe and foot without becoming a diagram.
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: Clean white shoe whose rounded pods leave coral contact impressions on the floor

values.SUBJECT: An adult athlete sits resting on a simple bench in a dark equipment room, hands relaxed on knees; a separate close panel shows fingertips gently pressing one rounded outsole pod and the pod compressing slightly.
values.SCENE: Deep navy modular locker-room architecture opening into one pale ice-blue product-light panel; white apparel and a coral shoe sole.
values.DESIGN_DIRECTION: Make feedback intimate and tactile rather than explosive. Contrast a small still seated figure with an oversized macro of a pod responding to a fingertip; quiet red accents and generous dark negative space carry the mood.
values.PRODUCT_OR_PROP: White concept shoe with a coral sole, one rounded pod compressing under a fingertip
